scenario: The ego vehicle travels through a busy commercial street and stops behind a minivan that suddenly brakes and opens its door.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along the road, decelerates, and comes to a complete stop behind a minivan.

adversarials.behavior: The white car turns left across the ego's path from the opposite direction.
The dark-colored car travels straight ahead in the opposite lane, passing the ego vehicle.
The minivan travels forward in the same lane as the ego, suddenly brakes to a stop, and then opens its rear passenger door.
The bicycle travels in the same direction as the ego on the right side of the road.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight multi-lane commercial street with buildings on both sides. A white car approaches from the opposite direction on the left, a dark car travels in the opposite lane, a minivan is directly ahead in the ego's lane, and a bicycle is on the right side of the road.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a safe following distance from the minivan ahead, and the scenario terminates when the ego comes to a complete stop behind the minivan with its door open.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right-hand sidewalk near the buildings.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the dashboard camera vehicle. Four adversarials: white turning car, dark opposite car, minivan ahead, and bicycle on right. 2. Chronology: Initially all vehicles approach; midpoint white car turns left, dark car passes, minivan brakes; ending ego stops behind minivan with open door. 3. Evidence: minivan's brake lights activate and it stops, then rear door visibly opens; white car's trajectory arcs left across ego's path; bicycle maintains position on right roadside.
